summary: Brain-JEPA官方权重已取得并严格加载，完整450×160合成输入得到768维表示，与独立注意力公式复算最大差3.58e-06。模型技术接入完成，尚无患者预测或新AUC。
boundary: 本轮只用合成信号验证完整编码器。450区名称顺序已核对；固定MNI图谱、时间采样和本地预处理差异仍须在一例真实输入上检查。
next: 下一步分别提取Tian50与Schaefer400的一例无标签时序，核对覆盖与旧AAL重提；采用事先明确的时间与整段标准化策略，再进入源训练内同输入FC、随机和预训练比较。

inference.implementation: Original encoder and weights; SDPA attention compared to original 64-token path and full independent explicit chunked attention. No external flash_attn package.
inference.pooling: Mean all 4500 tokens then unit/zero LayerNorm eps1e-6, as initialized and frozen in author linear probe; no classification head.

atlas.spatial_caveat: UKB source uses individual native-space cortical parcellation. Current fixed MNI group atlas is a local adaptation, not identical source preprocessing.
atlas.normalization_caveat: Source uses ICA-clean BOLD regional means; local confound regression, filtering and centering differ.
atlas.gradient_row_validation: 450 rows match declared ordering; no independent reconstruction of source gradients performed.
